## AI Engineering Roles Report

- **Job Availability**:
  - **Singapore**: 7,467 AI Engineer jobs available on Jobstreet [sg.jobstreet.com](https://sg.jobstreet.com/ai-engineer-jobs).
  - **Global**: 13,667 Artificial Intelligence Engineer jobs on Indeed [indeed.com](https://www.indeed.com/q-Artificial-Intelligence-Engineer-jobs.html).
  - **Remote Options**: 8,594 fully remote AI Engineer roles on Indeed [indeed.com](https://www.indeed.com/q-ai-engineer-l-anywhere-fully-remote-jobs.html).

- **Salary Range (US)**:
  - **Base Salary**: $99,578 to $134,188.
  - **Total Compensation**: Up to $242,507 in 2026 [coursera.org](https://www.coursera.org/articles/artificial-intelligence-salary), [futureproofing.dev](https://www.futureproofing.dev/resources/ai-talent-gap/ai-engineer-salary-trends).

- **Requirements**:
  - Skills in **machine learning, deep learning, natural language processing**, and proficiency in **Python** and frameworks like **TensorFlow or PyTorch**.
  - Problem-solving, data analysis, and cross-functional collaboration are emphasized [resources.rework.com](https://resources.rework.com/libraries/job-description-templates/ai-engineer), [foundit.in](https://www.foundit.in/career-advice/artificial-intelligence-engineer-job-description/).

- **Company Culture**:
  - Focus on **technical expertise, problem-solving, and collaboration**.
  - Remote work options are common, with some companies offering **flexible work environments** and **supportive leadership** [jobsbyculture.com](https://jobsbyculture.com/blog/best-ai-companies-for-engineers-2026), [builtin.com](https://builtin.com/companies/type/artificial-intelligence-companies/reputation/best-workplace).
